meta.model_call: anny.create_fullbody_model(rig="default", topology="default", local_changes="all", remove_unattached_vertices=True, triangulate_faces=True, pose_parameterization="local-bone", bone_orientation="blender-rootidentity", skinning_method="lbs")
meta.forward_call: model(pose_parameters=B x 163 x 4 x 4, phenotype_kwargs={name: tensor([v])}, local_changes_kwargs={label: tensor([v])})
meta.units: metres; +Z up; the body faces -Y; +X is the body's left

checksum_definitions.index_weighted: sum over rows i=1..N of i*(x_i + 2*y_i + 3*z_i), divided by N

meta.rest_vs_posed: rest_vertices = output['rest_vertices'] (template frame, before skinning); posed_vertices = output['vertices'] (after local-bone FK and LBS; the identity pose puts the root bone head at the origin)
